Behavior's call casts at the call site rather than asserting a signature the bytes do not carry.

daObjHmBskt_c_classInit and g_profile_HM_BASKET are reconstructed source-style names: SM64DS proves the RTTI class daObjHmBskt_c, the HM_BASKET registry ID, the descriptor/factory relationship, the 0x4e0 allocation size and the vtable identity; later EAD lineage supplies the spelling prior. Behavior keeps the four-word volatile stack reservation the pre-promotion shard carried; without it the body is 17 words short of the cartridge's. It costs that one member its no_codegen_trick reading and nothing else, because every hand-written member carries its own @symbol boundary.
The two destructor variants carry no @symbol marker on purpose: they have no definition text in the TU, and tools/tiers.py scores them through the inline definition in include/daObjHmBskt_c.h.
